title: Trip model and API
goal: Trips persist with their days and stops
acceptance: Trip: name, start and end dates, from and to (home by default, from a home setting), stops per day referencing places
Validated API and pure helpers in src/app/core with tests
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
